contexte: 1948-09-20; Max Dehn; Raymond Trayer; Warren Jennerjahn; Betty Jennerjahn

contexte: 1948-09-24; Mervin Lane

contexte: 1948-09-29; Charles Olson; Josef Albers; Edward Dahlberg
